comment: Clean texts of AIOS v0.7.0…v0.8.3 as fingerprints, for the 0.9 migration (system/migrate-0.9.mjs). Generated by scripts/gen-migrate-base.mjs of the engine repo; do not edit by hand. whole = sha256 of the file (BOM dropped, CRLF → LF); lines = first 16 hex of sha256 of each non-empty line (BOM, CR and trailing spaces dropped); pairs = the rows of the 'No folder yet' table of each map.

user/CONTEXT.md: biography, expertise, results of personality or strengths assessments
health now: conditions, limits, allergies, medication, food and training routine
`health/health.md`; a dated record (a test, a doctor's conclusion) → `health/<what>-<YYMMDD>.md`
family and close ones — only what is shared: anniversaries, traditions, plans
`relationships/relationships.md`. A fact about the other person (their birthday, diet, job) → their note in `people/`
personal money: income, spending, capital, debts, taxes and deadlines, goals
what the user is learning and wants to learn
`home/household.md`; the list of documents with expiry dates → `home/documents.md`
beliefs and faith, and what follows from them for an agent
business/<slug>/CONTEXT.md: the brand: identity, positioning, story, strategy, brand voice (how a person writes is not here — voices live in `system/voices/`)
`brand/<what>.md`; colours, logo, fonts → `brand/visual.md`
an audience segment
`avatars/<segment>.md`
a competitor
`competitors/<name>.md`
the market: the picture as it is now; what to keep an eye on; a dated study
`market/market.md`; `market/watchlist.md`; `market/<what>-<YYMMDD>.md`
a product: what the customer gets, the mechanism, unit cost. Not the price and not the terms of sale (guarantee, bonuses, deadline) — they live in the offer
`products/<product>.md`
where to send a person: an offer or a lead magnet (status, type, link, price, and its full design)
`offers/<short-name>.md` — format and picking rules: `system/offers.md`
channels: the list of channels; short links
`channels/channels.md`; `channels/links.md`
rows that a collector or an integration gathers (statistics, payments)
`data/` — nothing by hand
content — marketing materials: a sales page, a promo article (advertorial), an email, a post, an article

`content/<type>/<name>.md` — one folder per type: `sales-pages/`, `promo-articles/`, `emails/`, `posts/`, `articles/`. The channel a piece is for (a site, a mailing list, a social network) goes in its frontmatter as `channel:`, never into a folder name
an earlier plan, after the user has given a new one in its place
`plans/plan-<start YYMMDD>-<end YYMMDD>.md` — never read at session start (`AGENTS.md` › Records)
how a sale goes and how long it takes, what a good lead looks like, the sales method, payment terms
`sales/sales.md`
what customers keep asking, and the answers
`sales/faq.md`
the customer base as it is today: how many, which segment brings what money, where the list lives
`customers/customers.md`
proof to show a buyer: years on the market, customers served, results in numbers, cases and testimonials
`proof/proof.md`
margin by product, cost of acquisition by channel, spending, budgets and limits
`finance/economics.md`; a period report → `finance/report-<YYYY-MM>.md`
team, contractors, partners: who answers for what
`operations/team.md` (the person as a person → a note in `people/`)
criteria for decisions, and longer rules that only some jobs need (the short ones every agent must follow are in `core/business.md`)
`operations/rules.md`
the legal entity in detail: its form, tax regime, details for contracts and invoices
`operations/legal.md`
how a recurring job is done
`operations/processes/<name>.md`
